purpose: T0 region unit: define, once and outside the loop, the data-defined spatial units (per-source surface segments with cross-source location pairing) to which one continuous responsibility attaches. It decides neither source authority nor temporal change nor registration.

inputs.partition_semantics: Exact source-specific scene-local XYZ float32 bytes produced before M3C2 core sampling. Existing ALS bytes carry the frozen z-bridge; delta0 = 0 and T0 estimates no registration.

algorithm.name: DETERMINISTIC_SOURCE_CELL_REGION_GROWING_PAIRING_v1_1
algorithm.selection_rule: base fixed before any output and without score-only references; fine/coarse are parameter-sensitivity diagnostics only.

provenance.grow_max_plane_distance_m: scripts/p2/arrgs_v1/real_scene.py ransac_planes tol=0.15 (S1 legacy) for base
provenance.cell_size_m: rule: sparser-source mean spacing rounded up (ALS 0.21 m -> 0.25 m); pilot MVS 139,033 points -> 36,104 cells, ALS 20,189 -> 15,992 cells
provenance.grow_radius_m: new registration: exceeds the cell diagonal (0.433 m) and reaches the 2-cell face neighbour (0.5 m)
provenance.minimum_unit_area_m2: new registration: lower observability bound is re-evaluated by T1 r
provenance.seed_max_surface_variation: new registration: stricter than surface_patch_v1 maximum_bridge_surface_variation 0.15
provenance.normal_radius_m: source_relation_v1 m3c2.normal_diameter_m 4.0 / 4 at cell scale (new registration)
provenance.normal_min_neighbors: new registration: source_relation_v1 minimum_normal_points 10 reduced to 8 at 0.25 m cell scale
provenance.refit_condition_ratio: new registration: in-plane conditioning guard for PCA refits (D-1b)

algorithm.coverage_rule: Every occupied working cell of both sources belongs to exactly one unit; nothing is deleted; unassigned is impossible by construction and validated.
algorithm.unit_definition_rule: Units are defined on frozen source data only; no Gaussian, render residual, learned color, or registration estimate participates.
algorithm.pairing_rule: D-1e': window measured along the Existing ALS cell normal (t = (d_u - n_u.x_p)/(n_u.n_p), |t| <= h_pair, in-plane distance of the hit to the unit core <= pair_inplane_radius_m); rough MVS units use the M3C2 cylinder along the ALS normal; invalid ALS normals fall back to distance-only rules and are flagged per cell.
algorithm.prior_layer_rule: D-1k: planar MVS units whose prior side contains an ALS segment group offset by more than prior_layer_split_offset_m from the majority group are carved by that group's in-plane footprint when it covers >= minimum_unit_area_m2; otherwise mixed_prior=1.
algorithm.cell_size_rule: cell_size_m = mean point spacing of the sparser source (Existing ALS ~22 pts/m2 -> 0.21 m) rounded up to 0.25 m, so the sparser source keeps ~1 point per occupied cell and the denser MVS is reduced to a comparable working density; all physical thresholds (normal radius, growth radius, minimum area, extent cap, pairing window) are in metres and independent of the cell size. The sensitivity sweep above measures the remaining dependence.
